note: Curated catalog of skills/agents Hina + agent-router can route to. Used by scripts/hina-bootstrap.js to (a) report a capability gap vs the local inventory and (b) emit exact install commands. Nothing is installed without explicit user consent. TWO CLASSES: (1) SPECIALIST SUITES (ecc, ruflo, gstack, llm-council, wshobson, voltagent, official, marketing) are ADDITIVE — install as many as you like; each behaves differently and more specialists = better routing, no conflict. (2) MEMORY engines are NOT additive — exactly ONE, and only as a BACKEND behind Hina (single source of truth, single session-start injection) via an adapter; never run two memory engines or one alongside Hina's own file memory. MEMORY DECISION (3-reviewer debate, 2026-06-16): claude-mem chosen as the single backend candidate over Claude-User-Memory (inert until Pinecone/Mem0 wired) and awesome-memory (a recall primitive). entries marked verify need their exact repo/package confirmed before install.

entries.name: claude-plugins-official
entries.title: Anthropic official plugins
entries.why: Official Anthropic plugin marketplace. Safe broad baseline — first marketplace to add for a fresh user.

entries.name: ecc
entries.title: ECC (Every Commit Counts)
entries.why: Largest single suite: per-language reviewers, security-reviewer, planner, tdd-guide, build-resolvers, design tools. Broadest coverage in one install — the highest-value specialist supply.

entries.name: ruflo
entries.title: Ruflo
entries.why: Swarm + specialist agents: researcher, reviewer, testgen, security-audit, SPARC/workflow orchestration. Strong research + multi-agent coverage.

entries.name: gstack
entries.title: gstack
entries.why: QA/design/ship + plan-review skills (plan-ceo-review, plan-eng-review, design-review, office-hours, browse). NOTE: installed via its own setup script into the skills dir, NOT a marketplace plugin — the bootstrap can't auto-detect it from known_marketplaces, and the repo slug needs verifying.

entries.name: llm-council
entries.title: llm-council
entries.why: Multi-model planning council: independent plans from several CLI agents, anonymized, judged + merged. Needs the council member CLIs (codex/gemini/opencode) configured to run a real cross-vendor council; degrades to fewer members otherwise. Verify source before install.

entries.name: wshobson-agents
entries.title: wshobson/agents
entries.why: Multi-harness catalog of specialist subagents. Pure routing supply. Safe.

entries.name: voltagent-subagents
entries.title: VoltAgent/awesome-claude-code-subagents
entries.why: 100+ specialized subagents across dev use-cases. Broadens the route-target pool. Safe.

entries.name: marketingskills
entries.title: marketingskills
entries.why: Marketing scenario coverage (copy, campaigns, positioning). Additive; install if you do marketing/GTM work.

entries.name: claude-mem
entries.title: claude-mem
entries.why: THE single memory entry (debate winner). Auto-captures + AI-compresses observations to SQLite, injects at session start — the strongest standalone engine, hence the best candidate to ADOPT as Hina's memory backend instead of rebuilding flat-JSON memory. Conditions: (1) adopt via an adapter so Hina stays the single source of truth and the only injector; (2) do NOT run alongside Hina's own file memory; (3) verify the exact package/repo before install. Runs a background worker + hooks.

entries.name: claude-code-router
entries.title: Claude Code Router
entries.why: Proxies Claude Code to other LLM providers per request. DIFFERENT problem (model selection, not skill selection) and HIGH risk: reroutes how Claude Code connects to models and can disrupt your whole setup, including the current session. Cataloged for awareness, not for the default install.
